nodes.label: Production Deploy Job (deploy-production)
nodes.rationale: Triggered by push to deployment-prod: npm ci + npm run build, scp dist/* to a temp dir, ssh clears the web root, moves files in, and chowns www-data. Redeploy = replace static bundle.

nodes.label: VITE_API_BASE Opaque API Prefix (cloaking)
nodes.rationale: Setting repo var VITE_API_BASE=/_dk switches the built bundle to a cloaked path; must only be done AFTER nginx maps /_dk/ to backend /api/. Unset falls back to /api (no-op).

nodes.label: Staging Deploy Job (deploy-staging)
nodes.rationale: Triggered by push to release/staging: builds with --mode staging and VITE_API_URL_STAGING, then the same scp+ssh temp-dir-swap deploy to the staging web root.

nodes.label: ProtectShowcase Surfacing on Homepage
nodes.rationale: ProtectShowcase (animated anti-scam live risk check) was already built but never rendered anywhere. Surfaced high on Home.jsx as the single strongest trust differentiator vs price-only BD competitors (MuthoPhone, PriceMama, BDStall). Demonstrates flagging bKash-personal-number and below-market scam patterns.

nodes.label: Bangla Brand Line in Hero
nodes.rationale: Added the Bangla phrase দাম কেমন? ('how's the price?') under the H1. The brand name is the everyday Bangla phrase for 'what's the price?' — a memorable local asset. Renders crisply because the Hind Siliguri Bangla font is already loaded.

nodes.label: Trust Micro-proofs Under Hero Search
nodes.rationale: Compact row at point of action: 'Real prices, never fake · Scam-risk checked · Free for shoppers'. Trust signals placed next to the primary action lift buyer confidence (conversion research). Reuses already-imported BadgeCheck, ShieldCheck, Sparkles icons.

nodes.label: Trust-first Emphasis Reorder
nodes.rationale: Page reordered to price proof -> trust/anti-scam (Protect) -> how it works -> social proof -> FAQ. Trust is the #1 reason BD shoppers hesitate post-Evaly, so trust is no longer buried.

nodes.label: axios Client (src/api/api.js)
nodes.rationale: The single place that talks to the backend; all endpoint helpers live here.

nodes.label: SearchBar Autosuggest (src/components/SearchBar.jsx)
nodes.rationale: Debounced 180ms autosuggest dropdown with up/down/Enter/Esc nav, backed by GET /api/search/suggest. Selecting a row goes to the product page; bare Enter runs a full search.

nodes.label: SearchResults Page (src/pages/SearchResults.jsx)
nodes.rationale: Calls GET /api/search?q= for synchronous DB-first instant search served from the indexed catalog; renders grouped per-product cards with a per-seller price table.

nodes.label: Dashboard Page (src/pages/Dashboard.jsx)
nodes.rationale: Renders live /api/dashboard/stats — products / shops / reviews / price points.

nodes.label: SPA Root Shell + main.jsx Entry
nodes.rationale: #root div mounted by the module script /src/main.jsx (Vite entry).

nodes.label: SEO / OpenGraph / Twitter Meta Tags
nodes.rationale: Static title/description plus og:title, og:description, og:type, twitter:card. Positions Damkemon as 'find the cheapest price across all of Bangladesh' / one search across 60+ BD shops.

nodes.label: Google Fonts (Fraunces, DM Sans, JetBrains Mono, Hind Siliguri)
nodes.rationale: Preconnected and loaded webfonts including Hind Siliguri for Bangla script rendering.
